name: vital-expert
description: Vital.Expert plugins for Cowork. Digital Health packs, vital-trusted (sole Prove/Build/Core pack; optional vvfy_ for live Prove tools), vital-navigator-outcomes (legacy navigator-ai-investment), vital-es-target-evaluation-due-diligence (CF-01.02.06 live-test), vital-mlr-review, and vital-decision-companion. The vital-verify plugin was retired 8 November 2026.

plugins.name: vital-trusted
plugins.description: Nineteen foundational skills for daily life-sciences work (Core / Build / Prove). Offline-first; optional TRUSTED Prove live MCP via vvfy_ key (https://mcp.vital.expert/api/mcp/verify, server id trusted-prove). The vital-verify plugin is retired — install this pack only.

plugins.name: vital-mlr-review
plugins.description: Multi-jurisdiction Medical–Legal–Regulatory board preparation. Host writes Medical, Legal, and Regulatory chairs; never approves. Tools on mcp.vital.expert/api/mcp/mlr-review (vmlr_). Claim checks stay on Verify.

plugins.name: vital-decision-companion
plugins.description: Decision Companion: the FOCUSED coaching skills (Frame, Options, Criteria, Unknowns, Score, Examine, Decide). Coaches a business decision one question at a time and leaves the choice with the person. The Decision Connector adds the scored comparison and the decision record; Ontology Navigator and Verify tools are called, not copied.

plugins.name: vital-navigator-outcomes
plugins.description: Outcome Navigator (CF-01.06.01): investment decisions and measurement — from value-at-stake to value realized. GenAI is a vertical, not the brand. Tools on vont_; optional Curator steward skills (pull/classify/process/decide/enrich) on vcur_. Marketplace v0.3.1-live-test.

plugins.name: vital-es-target-evaluation-due-diligence
plugins.description: Target Evaluation & Due Diligence (CF-01.02.06). Nine skills + integrated report. Standard KA Pass (v9); Draft 0.1.1-live-test for Cowork. Not Marketplace Done. Optional vont_/verify keys; offline script-first.

plugins.name: navigator-ai-investment
plugins.description: Legacy id for Outcome Navigator. Prefer vital-navigator-outcomes@vital-expert. Tools run on the Ontology Navigator connector (vont_ key).
